add-full-size-graph-to-pdf-page.description: Shows how to create a Graph object that matches the page dimensions of a PDF, add a rectangle shape, and embed the graph into the page using Aspose.Pdf.

add-gradient-ellipse-graphs-to-pdfs.title: Add Gradient Ellipse Graphs to PDFs in Parallel
add-gradient-ellipse-graphs-to-pdfs.description: Demonstrates processing multiple PDF files concurrently and adding a graph with gradient‑filled ellipses to each page using Aspose.Pdf.

add-graph-rectangle-watermark-to-pdf.description: The example loads each PDF from an input folder, creates a Graph that matches the page size, adds a light‑gray rectangle as a watermark, and saves the modified documents to an output folder.

add-rounded-rectangle-with-fill-to-pdf-g.title: Add Rounded Rectangle with Fill to PDF Graph
add-rounded-rectangle-with-fill-to-pdf-g.description: Creates a PDF document, adds a Graph container, and draws a rounded rectangle with a solid fill and border color.

add-rounded-rectangle-with-fill.title: Add Rounded Rectangle with Fill to PDF
add-rounded-rectangle-with-fill.description: Shows how to draw a rectangle with rounded corners, set a corner radius, and apply a solid fill using Aspose.Pdf's Graph and Rectangle classes.

add-solid-red-rectangle-to-pdf-graph.title: Add Solid Red Rectangle To Pdf Graph

add-unfilled-arc-with-custom-stroke.title: Add Unfilled Arc with Custom Stroke to PDF

create-custom-star-shape-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to generate a star polygon with a configurable number of points, fill color, and outline, and embed it in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's Graph and Path objects.
